contact.faqTitle: Questions we hear at the desk
contact.faq1q: How do I place an order?
contact.faq1a: Add books to the cart, open checkout, and choose delivery plus a payment method. New Star confirms the demo order with a number that starts with NS-. Nothing is charged.
contact.faq2q: Are the notes available as a digital PDF?
contact.faq2a: Yes. Choose “Digital download PDF” at checkout. In this demo the file is not generated; the confirmation simply records that you asked for the PDF.
contact.faq3q: How long does delivery take in Egypt?
contact.faq3a: Home delivery is listed as 2–5 days across governorates, with a 45 EGP shipping fee in the demo. Pickup from the Downtown Cairo desk is free. These times are sample copy, not a live courier promise.
contact.faq4q: Which payment methods can I use?
contact.faq4a: The checkout demo offers cash on delivery, card, Vodafone Cash, InstaPay, and a sample bank transfer. Card numbers never leave the browser, and no wallet or bank is actually contacted.
contact.faq5q: Can I return a printed book?
contact.faq5a: Unmarked printed books can be returned within 7 days of delivery in this sample policy. Digital PDFs are not returnable once the download is recorded. Write to the desk with your NS- order number.
contact.faq6q: Do promo codes work on digital orders?
contact.faq6a: STAR10 takes 10% off the book subtotal, and NEWSTAR50 takes 50 EGP off. Both apply before shipping, including digital orders where shipping is free. Unknown codes show an error and do not change the total.

ns01.title: O.Level Physics Past Papers 2020–2024 — Variant 2
ns01.description: Five years of Cambridge O.Level Physics papers arranged by topic, with the Variant 2 sessions Dr. Hana uses in class. Margin notes flag the command words that cost marks. A short checklist at the back shows which papers to sit under timed conditions.

ns02.title: O.Level Biology Classified Questions — Variant 1
ns02.description: Classified Variant 1 questions from cells through ecology, grouped the way Ms. Laila revises them. Each set ends with a one-page recap of the diagrams students are asked to label. Ideal after the first full pass of the syllabus.

ns03.title: O.Level Chemistry Notes — Variant 1
ns03.description: Dr. Omar’s full O.Level Chemistry notes for the Edexcel Variant 1 track, written in short blocks with worked mole calculations. Practical write-ups sit beside the theory so lab questions are not a separate scramble. Includes a formula sheet students may copy into their own books.

ns04.title: O.Level Geography Past Papers 2019–2024 — Variant 3
ns04.description: Cambridge O.Level Geography papers from 2019 to 2024, Variant 3 only, with Mr. Tarek’s map-skill reminders on the facing page. Case-study prompts for rivers, population, and tourism are indexed at the front. Print it or keep the PDF open beside a blank outline map.

ns05.title: O.Level Physics Answers — Variant 1
ns05.description: Worked answers for Mr. Karim’s Variant 1 O.Level Physics question bank. Steps are written out in full for calculations and in mark-point form for explain questions. Pair it with the classified set rather than reading it on its own.

ns06.title: O.Level Biology Notes — Variant 2
ns06.description: Oxford AQA O.Level Biology notes for Variant 2, with the diagrams Ms. Nadia expects students to redraw from memory. Key terms are defined in plain language before the formal wording. A weekly revision rota covers the book in six sittings.

ns07.title: O.Level Chemistry Mark Scheme Pack — Variant 3
ns07.description: Mark schemes for the Variant 3 Cambridge O.Level Chemistry papers Dr. Hana assigns as weekend work. Acceptable alternative wording is highlighted so students stop losing points for synonyms. Use it after a timed paper, not during one.

ns08.title: Pre IG Physics Notes with Worked Examples — Variant 2
ns08.description: A bridge-year Physics notebook for students moving into IGCSE. Dr. Hana walks through forces, electricity, and waves with one worked example and one try-it question per idea. Variant 2 paper style is used in the practice boxes.

ns09.title: Pre IG Biology Mark Scheme Pack — Variant 1
ns09.description: Short mark schemes for Pre IG Biology tests in the Edexcel Variant 1 style. Ms. Nadia annotates where a labelled sketch earns the point that a sentence misses. Useful for parents marking weekend quizzes at home.

ns10.title: Pre IG Chemistry Classified — Variant 3
ns10.description: Classified Pre IG Chemistry questions, Variant 3, from separation techniques through acids and bases. Mr. Karim orders them from recall to extended response. An answer grid at the end lets students score a topic in ten minutes.

ns11.title: Pre IG Geography Answers Booklet — Variant 2
ns11.description: Model answers for the Pre IG Geography booklet Ms. Laila sets before the first mock. Map-reading responses show the measurement, the sentence, and the unit. Variant 2 command words are explained on the first spread.

ns12.title: Pre IG Physics Past Papers — Variant 1
ns12.description: Edexcel-style Pre IG Physics papers, Variant 1, selected by Dr. Omar for the term before IGCSE choices. Each paper has a suggested timing and a list of formulae that should already be memorised. Space is left for working on the print edition.

ns13.title: Pre IG Biology Classified — Variant 3
ns13.description: Topic-sorted Variant 3 questions for Pre IG Biology, with the practicals Ms. Laila runs in the second term. Food tests, osmosis, and enzymes each have their own block. A glossary keeps the spelling of process names consistent.

ns14.title: A.S Level Physics Past Papers 2018–2024 — Variant 1
ns14.description: Cambridge A.S Physics papers from 2018 through 2024 for Variant 1, the set Dr. Omar uses for Saturday mocks. Papers are ordered newest first so the current command style comes before older wording. A cover sheet tracks scores across the year.

ns15.title: A.S Level Biology Notes — Variant 2
ns15.description: Edexcel A.S Biology notes for Variant 2, written as two-page chapters Ms. Nadia can finish in a double period. Cell structure, transport, and genetics include the exact graph types that appear in papers. Summary tables are built to be recopied, not just highlighted.

ns16.title: A.S Level Chemistry Mark Schemes — Variant 1
ns16.description: Clean mark schemes for Cambridge A.S Chemistry Variant 1 papers, with Mr. Karim’s notes on organic mechanisms. Points that must be in order are marked so students stop listing ideas at random. Best used the evening after a timed paper.

ns17.title: A.S Level Geography Classified — Variant 3
ns17.description: Classified A.S Geography questions for Variant 3, covering hydrology, atmosphere, and population. Mr. Tarek pairs each 10-mark prompt with a case study students in Cairo schools usually already know. Data-response figures are redrawn for clearer printing.

ns18.title: A.S Level Chemistry Answers — Variant 2
ns18.description: Full worked answers for the Edexcel A.S Chemistry Variant 2 classified pack. Calculation steps keep units visible, which is where most papers lose a mark. Dr. Omar adds a short comment when a common wrong answer still earns partial credit.

ns19.title: A.2 Level Physics Classified — Variant 2
ns19.description: The A.2 Physics classified set Dr. Hana updates every exam season. Fields, nuclear physics, and astrophysics are split into Variant 2 question styles with space for working. A final mixed paper sits at the back for the last fortnight.

ns20.title: A.2 Level Biology Past Papers — Variant 1
ns20.description: Cambridge A.2 Biology past papers, Variant 1, chosen by Ms. Laila because the synoptic questions match her revision order. Energy, homeostasis, and gene technology are tabbed in the print copy. The PDF keeps those tabs as a linked contents page.

ns21.title: A.2 Level Chemistry Notes — Variant 3
ns21.description: Oxford AQA A.2 Chemistry notes for Variant 3, focused on equilibria, aromatics, and analysis. Dr. Omar writes mechanisms in the same direction every time so they are easier to memorise. Each chapter ends with three questions and no answers — those live in the answers booklet.

ns22.title: A.2 Level Geography Mark Scheme — Variant 2
ns22.description: Mark schemes for Edexcel A.2 Geography Variant 2 essays and data responses. Mr. Tarek shows the difference between a point that is named and a point that is developed. A one-page reminder covers levels of response before the paper-by-paper detail.

ns23.title: A.2 Level Biology Classified — Variant 3
ns23.description: Variant 3 classified questions for Cambridge A.2 Biology, edited by Ms. Nadia after the latest syllabus tweak. Synoptic items are kept in a separate section so they are not sprung on students too early. Diagrams are redrawn in a consistent line weight for home printing.

ns24.title: A.2 Level Physics Mark Scheme — Variant 1
ns24.description: Cambridge A.2 Physics mark schemes for Variant 1, with Mr. Karim’s error-carried-forward notes in the margin. Numerical ranges are spelled out where the official wording is easy to misread. Use alongside the past-paper pack from the same years.

ns25.title: SAT Subject Test Physics — Classified Drills, Variant 1
ns25.description: Classified drills for students adding SAT Physics to an A.S year. Mr. Karim maps each drill back to the Variant 1 mechanics and electricity they already study. Timing notes assume a shorter stem than Cambridge papers, which is the usual stumble.

ns26.title: SAT Subject Test Biology — Past Papers, Variant 2
ns26.description: A past-paper style SAT Biology pack for A.2 students who want extra multiple-choice mileage. Ms. Nadia aligns the ecology and genetics items with her Variant 2 classified order. An error log page is included for the questions missed twice.

ns27.title: SAT Chemistry Practice Notes — Variant 3
ns27.description: Compact SAT Chemistry notes for students already taking A.S Chemistry Variant 3. Dr. Hana keeps the periodic trends and stoichiometry pages to a single spread each. Practice clusters use the shorter SAT stem rather than a full structured paper.

ns28.title: IELTS Academic Writing for Chemistry Students — Variant 1
ns28.description: IELTS Academic writing frames built from chemistry data: graphs of rates, tables of yields, and process descriptions. Ms. Laila shows a Task 1 overview before the detail sentences. Variant 1 lab vocabulary is reused so the language lesson supports the science lesson.

ns29.title: IELTS Academic Reading: Geography Data Sets — Variant 2
ns29.description: Reading practice that uses geography data sets in the IELTS Academic style. Mr. Tarek chooses passages on climate, cities, and coasts that overlap with the Variant 2 case studies. Question types are labelled so students can see True/False/Not Given as its own skill.

ns30.title: Pre IG Geography Past Papers — Variant 1
ns30.description: Cambridge-style Pre IG Geography papers, Variant 1, with the map extracts Mr. Tarek prints on A3 when the class needs them larger. Questions move from location skills to short case studies. A timing strip at the top of each paper keeps the hour honest.

ns31.title: O.Level Geography Classified — Variant 2
ns31.description: Edexcel O.Level Geography questions sorted by theme for Variant 2. Mr. Tarek keeps settlement, industry, and energy in separate blocks with a mixed review at the end. Sketch-map prompts include a quiet reminder of what a title and scale are worth.
